title: Expense rollup into monthly report
description: Roll logged expenses into the income-vs-expense figure on the monthly report (LODGY-22).
acceptanceCriteria: Monthly report's expense total matches the sum of that month's expense entries

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Already built as part of LODGY-22, not a separate follow-on change: MonthlyReportViewModel.refresh() queries expenseRepository.getByHostelId(hostelId) and sums entries whose incurredOn falls in the selected month/year, and netIncome = totalCollected - totalExpense is shown directly on the report tile - there's no separate expense-rollup code path to add, this ticket's AC was the natural shape of 'build income vs expense correctly' from the start. Same build verification as LODGY-22 (`gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL). No incremental code change to note here beyond what LODGY-22's history already describes.
